Dear Wemark Team,

I am writing to apply for the Growth Track internship in your 2026 Internship Program. As a junior digital marketer with hands-on experience in SEO, content creation, and web development, I am eager to contribute to Wemark's projects and grow my skills in digital marketing, product ownership, and AI.

In my current role at Episto, I manage on-page SEO, write keyword-targeted content, and build WordPress sites, which has given me a solid foundation in driving organic growth. On my own project, mirook.com, I have implemented structured data and GEO techniques to improve visibility in AI-powered search engines, demonstrating my proactive approach to learning and applying new trends.

I am particularly excited about the opportunity to work in a real-world environment and collaborate with a team of professionals. My background in both technical and creative aspects of digital marketing makes me a versatile candidate ready to take on challenges.

Thank you for considering my application. I look forward to the possibility of contributing to Wemark's growth.

Best regards,

Dear Wemark Team,

I am excited to apply for the Growth Track internship in your 2026 Internship Program. As a junior digital marketer with a strong technical foundation and a passion for growth, I am eager to bring my skills to Wemark and contribute to your projects while developing professionally.

Currently, I work as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, where I manage on-page SEO for client websites, write keyword-targeted content, and build and maintain WordPress sites. This role has honed my ability to drive organic traffic and improve search rankings, skills directly relevant to the Growth Track's focus on digital marketing and product ownership.

Beyond my professional experience, I have developed my own project, mirook.com, where I have applied advanced SEO and GEO techniques, including structured data and entity optimization, to enhance visibility in both traditional and AI-powered search engines. This self-driven initiative demonstrates my commitment to staying ahead of industry trends and my ability to work independently.

I am particularly drawn to Wemark's internship program because it offers hands-on experience in a real working environment, which aligns perfectly with my career goals. I am eager to collaborate with a team of professionals, learn from their expertise, and contribute to meaningful projects. My background in both technical and creative aspects of digital marketing makes me a versatile team member, ready to take on challenges and grow.

I am based in Zwijndrecht, Belgium, and am available for the full three-month program in Baku. I am fluent in English and Turkish, with a working knowledge of Dutch, and I am quick to adapt to new tools and environments.

Thank you for considering my application. I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how I can contribute to Wemark's growth.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok

Baver Ok
Digital Marketing · SEO · GEO · Content · Web
Zwijndrecht, Belgium | +32 470 42 48 36 | baverok@gmail.com | linkedin.com/in/baverok

## Profile
Junior digital marketer with a technical foundation in web design, SEO, and GEO (Generative Engine Optimization). At Episto, I run on-page SEO, keyword-targeted content, and full-cycle WordPress site build and maintenance for client sites. On my own project (mirook.com) I've applied structured data, entity optimization, and technical SEO/GEO audits to improve visibility across both traditional and AI-powered search engines. Comfortable across content management, social media coordination, and performance reporting; quick to pick up new tools and platforms, and growing into analytics, e-commerce content management, and campaign support. Based in Zwijndrecht, next to Antwerp. Works in English and Turkish; Dutch: B1, currently taking classes to improve further.

## Core skills
- SEO & GEO: on-page SEO, keyword research, technical SEO audits, structured data / JSON-LD schema, entity optimization, GEO & AEO (AI search visibility)
- Content & CMS: SEO blog & content writing, editorial content publishing, website content management, WordPress site building
- Web & build: WordPress, Elementor, Astra theme, responsive web design, Canva, AI-assisted content tools
- Analytics & reporting: Google Analytics, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Ads
- Social: social media content & integration
- Languages: English (professional), Turkish (native), Dutch (B1)

## Experience

### Junior Digital Marketer — Episto (Remote), 2026–present
- Own on-page SEO for client websites, from keyword research to publishing, improving organic visibility and search rankings
- Write keyword-targeted blog content for client websites to grow organic traffic
- Build and maintain client websites in WordPress using Elementor and the Astra theme, including content uploads and page updates
- Track site performance with SEMrush, Ahrefs, Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and Google Ads to guide SEO and content decisions

### Warehouse & Logistics — Katoen Natie (Antwerp), 2025–2026
- Maintained accuracy and efficiency in a high-volume, fast-paced logistics environment

### Front-End Developer — ViviDoctor (Belgium), 2018–2019
- Developed and optimized front-end features for a healthcare web application (AngularJS, JavaScript)

## Projects

### mirook.com — Website Design, SEO & GEO (2025–present)
- Designed and built a multi-page WordPress site (Elementor, Astra) for a Belgian youth chess champion: full site structure, on-page SEO, and social media integration (Instagram/Facebook)
- Implemented structured data (JSON-LD schema, including SportsEvent and FAQPage), entity/knowledge-graph markup, and an llms.txt file to improve visibility across traditional and AI-powered search engines (GEO/AEO)
- Ran iterative technical SEO/GEO audits, measurably raising the site's overall search-health score

## Education
- Karel de Grote Hogeschool, Antwerp — Coursework in Applied Computer Science (2022–2025)
- Celal Bayar University, Türkiye — Coursework in Computer Science (2012–2016)
- Diyarbakır Anatolian High School, Türkiye — High School Diploma (2012)
